decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts took significant R&D investment, possibly through EU-funded projects, and fit the firm's announced direction toward multifunctional packaging wafers, so management will persist and treat slow uptake as temporary qualification delays.

The carrier wafer for smaller-diameter wafers was announced publicly as a launch, extends the firm's core carrier offering at low marginal cost, and matches its stated push into reusable carriers, so there is no reason to write it off.
